findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext drops the receiver's recorded logs
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a brand-new `TestLogger` instead of the receiver or a child sharing the same `Logs`. `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`, so when a test passes a `*TestLogger` into `NewLoggerMiddleware`, the log call is recorded on an unreachable new logger and the original logger's `InfoLogs` stays empty. Existing or new assertions that the middleware logged `Plugin Request Completed` will fail or silently stop covering the logging path. Return `f` (or a child wired to the same `Logs`) and, if needed, store the context attributes on that child.

findings.title: New contextual logger middleware is untested after behavior was moved
findings.body: The contextual logging behavior was moved out of the instrumentation middleware into this new middleware, but no test was added for it. The renamed metrics test only validates Prometheus metrics; it does not verify that `QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` enrich the context with `endpoint`, `pluginId`, `dsName`, `dsUID`, and `uname`, nor that `LoggerMiddleware` consumes those attributes. Because `LoggerMiddleware` no longer appends these fields itself, a regression in this middleware would silently remove all plugin/request metadata from `Plugin Request Completed` logs. Add a test that captures the contextual attributes observed by the logger.
